content.short: 0xequity lets users invest in real-world assets and DeFi from as low as $10.
content.description: 0xequity is a blockchain-based web and mobile application that enables users to invest across a diverse set of instruments, including real-world assets and DeFi, and to earn yields on-chain. Investable assets include residential and commercial properties, solar farms, gold, bonds, stocks, and various DeFi strategies. The platform also provides opportunities to lend, borrow, and earn yields on digital assets.
content.meta: 0xequity lets users invest in real-world assets and DeFi products to earn on-chain yields. Discover 0xequity and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
